description: HesabYar Phase 4 (per design-eng.md §17, §12, §7.4, §18 module 8): Iranian intelligence layer — standards registry + validators in the application service layer, effective-dated tax-policy registry, Iranian report validations with source provenance, Moadian test profiles + simulator, compliance center UI. Builds on branch ralph/phase-3 (FastAPI backend, 29+ REST endpoints, Persian Next.js dashboard, 730 Python tests green, full suite verified against Supabase). Spec: ~/workspace/user/files/design-eng_0_zaup.md (§12 standards/tax/Moadian, §7.4 table groups, §17 Phase 4). Exit criteria: each active rule is traceable, date-aware, tested and blocked when its source is not verified.

acceptanceCriteria: Alembic migration adds standard_sources, standard_revisions, standard_rules, validation_runs, validation_results (spec §7.4; normalized, typed columns, constraints + indexes; no EAV)

The 35-standard corpus (standards/ + validators/rules.yaml, 36 rules) is seeded into the registry with full provenance per standard revision: standard_code, revision_id, title, published_at, effective_from/to, source_authority, source_url, snapshot_uri, sha256, verification_status, verified_by/at (spec §12.1)

Verification statuses follow docs/CURRENT_RULES_1405.md: Standard 43 and 44 VERIFIED_TEXT with their effective dates; Standard 15 BLOCKED_SOURCE_GAP for periods beginning 1405/01/01+ (bundled text is the old revision — must never validate/post for 1405+ periods until the official revised-1404 text is imported)

Application validation service runs the existing closed DSL engine (domain/standards) over supplied financial data, persists a validation run + per-rule results, and reports coverage separately: source corpus coverage, rules implemented, rules verified, rules executed (spec §12.1 — never claim full compliance coverage from having a corpus)
Validation outcomes are exactly PASS / FAIL / NOT_APPLICABLE / ERROR; missing data or an unevaluable rule yields ERROR, never PASS (fail-closed)

REST endpoints (versioned /api/v1, RFC 9457 errors, API-key scopes standards:read / standards:validate): list standards with filters, get one standard + its revisions/rules, create a validation run, get a run with its results; OpenAPI updated; unit + integration tests green
userStories.description: As an accountant I want the Iranian standards registry and validators inside the application (not just files on disk), so validations are traceable, versioned and runnable through the API.

acceptanceCriteria: Alembic migration adds tax_sources, tax_policy_versions, tax_decisions (spec §7.4); rule year, performance year, filing year and effective date are separate persisted fields on every version (spec §12.2)

The 1405 parameter candidates from docs/CURRENT_RULES_1405.md §3 are seeded as CORROBORATED_CURRENT versions (VAT 10%, Art 84 exemption 4,800,000,000 IRR, Art 101 2,800,000,000 IRR, Art 100 ceiling 720,000,000,000 IRR for performance year 1404, 45% growth threshold) with their corroboration sources recorded

Production use of any CORROBORATED_CURRENT (or unverified/disputed/missing-source) version is BLOCKED by the service: resolving a policy for production returns a typed error naming the missing official source pin; the gate from CURRENT_RULES_1405.md is preserved, not bypassed

Tax decision service resolves the active policy version for a given date + company + rule, records the decision with its source version, and is tested for historical and future dates and effective-date boundaries
No annual VAT rate, exemption or threshold is hard-coded as a timeless constant anywhere in the codebase (grep-verified); all annual parameters come from the versioned registry

REST endpoints (scopes tax:read / tax:decide): list tax sources and policy versions with effective-date filters, get one version with its source, resolve a tax decision for a date/company; OpenAPI updated; unit + integration tests green
userStories.description: As an accountant I want tax rules versioned, effective-dated and traceable to official sources, so a rate is never a magic number and unverified rules can never silently apply.

acceptanceCriteria: Adapter gains a trial-balance read from POSTED moves via Tryton REST (new port method; closes the Phase 2 get_report gap for trial balance only — P&L, balance sheet and cash flow stay honestly deferred)

Report validation service runs standards rules over the live trial balance (and invoice/journal data via existing endpoints), persists report_snapshots for reproducibility, and attaches provenance to every figure: source endpoint, snapshot id, ruleset version, as-of date
Validation runs distinguish rules executed vs skipped (NOT_APPLICABLE) vs ERROR; coverage reporting shows corpus vs implemented vs verified vs executed counts; nothing computed from paginated lists

REST endpoints (scopes reports:read / standards:validate): GET trial balance for company/date range (with source metadata), POST a financial-statement validation run, GET the run with per-rule results + provenance; OpenAPI updated
Unit + integration tests green, including effective-date boundaries (Standard 44 applies from 1405/01/01, Standard 43 from 1404/01/01) and the Standard 15 block for 1405+ periods
userStories.description: As an accountant I want financial reports validated against Iranian standards with full source provenance, so I can trust a report and show where every figure came from.

acceptanceCriteria: Alembic migration adds moadian_profiles, moadian_documents, moadian_submissions, moadian_status_events (spec §7.4); secrets are never stored in plain text (test keys via env only; production keys belong in a secret manager — out of scope for this story)

Moadian profile schemas are versioned; every field/protocol claim in the profile points to an official technical specification or verified official source snapshot (research the official Moadian docs first — tax.gov.ir / intamedia — and record sources; do NOT embed undocumented protocol details in the accounting core, spec §12.3)
A simulator/fixture suite mimics the Moadian sandbox lifecycle (submit → accepted/rejected → status polling) before any production connectivity; production connectivity is NOT built in this phase

Submission flow uses the outbox pattern (outbox_events) and a reconciliation worker that polls the simulator and persists request/response hashes, timestamps, correlation IDs and official status evidence (spec §12.3)
Production submission requires explicit human approval (a recorded approval step); no LLM or automation can submit as an unreviewed side effect; draft-only creation is allowed without approval

REST endpoints (scopes moadian:read / moadian:submit): profiles CRUD, documents, submissions (draft → approved → queued → simulated status), status events; OpenAPI updated; unit + integration tests green against the simulator
userStories.description: As an accountant I want Moadian e-invoicing prepared with test profiles and a simulator, so submissions are rehearsed end-to-end before any real tax-system connection.

acceptanceCriteria: Compliance center in the dashboard (spec §18 module 8 «استانداردها و انطباق»): standards registry view with verification status + blocked badges, tax-policy view with effective dates and gated parameters clearly marked, validation runs + per-rule results, Moadian profiles/documents/submissions + status evidence, coverage dashboard (corpus vs implemented vs verified vs executed)

All new pages go through BFF routes to the Phase 4 APIs (no direct browser-to-backend, no browser-held credentials — standing Phase 3 pattern); VibeFarsi/FarsiUI components via the existing facade; Persian-only, RTL-first, light theme
No fake data: every figure comes from the live API; gated/blocked items show their reason in Persian; empty states are honest
Responsive + accessibility pass on the new pages (390px/320px + desktop, keyboard navigation, focus traps, contrast AA, no horizontal overflow)

Full Phase 4 e2e verification in a live browser against the real backend + Tryton (Supabase): login → compliance center → standards → tax policy → run a validation → Moadian simulator submission → logout; every page reachable, no console errors, no dead buttons; `pnpm -C apps/admin build`, typecheck, lint and all frontend tests pass; Python suite still green (730+ passed)
userStories.description: As an accountant I want a compliance center in the Persian dashboard, so standards, tax policy, validations and Moadian status are visible in one place.
